blocks.text: Salah is the fundamental deed that plays the most important part in carrying out the commands of Allah according to the way of Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ, so as to benefit directly from the power of Allah..

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (إِنَّ الصَّلوةَ تَنْهي عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Indeed, Salah restrains (the one who prays) from indecency and from what is detestable.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّلِحتِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلوةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ وَلَاخَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَاهُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Indeed, those who believe (in the One God), do good deeds, establish Salah and give Zakat — their (good) reward is with their Rabb; and there will be no fear upon them, nor will they grieve.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قُلْ لِّعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُقِيمُوا الصَّلوةَ وَيُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنهُمْ سِرّاً وَّعَلَانِيَةً مِّنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَّأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّابَيْعٌ فِيهِ وَلَاخِلَالٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) say to My servants who have (truly) believed that they should establish Salah, and spend secretly and openly out of what We have given them, "before that day comes on which there will be neither trading nor friendship (of any benefit)'!
